# China Mobile synthetic contract fixtures

> Simplified Chinese mirror: [`../../../docs/zh-CN/fixtures/CHINA_MOBILE.md`](../../../docs/zh-CN/fixtures/CHINA_MOBILE.md).

These files are hand-authored, synthetic, and sanitized representations of the public announcement-page, static JSON-list, detail-shell, and detail-JSON shapes used by the China Mobile Adapter. A contract test derives an image-only body variant from the synthetic campus fixture to verify same-origin image evidence without download or OCR. The files contain no downloaded source page, applicant data, credentials, real contact information, or application action.
